text_block_list.text:
While walking through town...
For some reason, I saw Matikanefukukitaru
rolling dice with an intensely serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, rolled a 2, an even number...
Taking the left path is the right move here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, whoa!?
I ran right into Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, to tell you the truth,
I received a revelation in my dream last night!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, right now,
a limited-time super power spot has appeared!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
She didn't tell me where, but no problem!
As long as I follow the guidance of these lucky dice, I'll surely reach the promised land!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...And so, while I was rolling the dice, that's when I ran into you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... I don't think this is a coincidence!
Could it be that you, Trainer, are the key person
sent to guide me to a power spot!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please! From here on out,
I need you to roll the dice, Trainer!

...With them expecting this much of me, I have no choice.
For now, as I roll the dice...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a 3! That means it's odd,
so take the right path... That's toward the station!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you're saying we take the train from here!
Let's head out right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu, I feel it, I really feel it~!
We're getting closer and closer to the power spot!
Isn't this thrilling, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which station should we get off at?!
Let's roll the dice and see!

"If I roll a 1, it's the next station. A 2 means two stops away...
If it's a 6, as far as I can go. Deciding that,
I roll the die in my palm, and..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Oh, a 1! That means at the next station..."

"...However, at that moment,
the train gave a violent lurch,
and the dice slipped from my palm..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Th-This is...!?
It turned into a 6!
choice_data_list: I wonder which one it'll be?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm... This is quite a difficult problem...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I leave this to you!
You always guide me in the right direction, after all!
choice_data_list: 1 = Let's get off at the next station
6 = Let's go as far as we can!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I wonder what's waiting for us, I can't wait to find out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! So this is the limited-time power spot!
I can definitely feel a special power radiating from it!

"...Setting aside how utterly ordinary the town looked,
I just kept rolling the dice
and walking through the streets."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look at that sign!
It says "Power Yaki"!
I wonder if it's a local delicacy?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What a perfect name for a power spot...!
We absolutely have to buy this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's go with lucky seven, so 7...
Or maybe 8 for good fortune would be nice too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!? There's a huge sculpture
in front of the art museum!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's sparkling as it catches the light!
Maybe the power of the sun is circulating
really nicely on the inside!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Let's try touching it together, Trainer!
Come on, right this way, this way!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Taaag!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was fun!
What a jam-packed day that was!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've had a blast and my energy is fully charged! As expected of a limited-time super power spot, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Um... what about you, Trainer-san?
I ended up dragging you around all day, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness~~~!
That means you got tons of energy from it too, right?!

I don't think anything supernatural actually happened,
but both Matikanefukukitaru and I are satisfied.
It'd be uncouth to overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I almost wish we received revelations like this
on a regular basis!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
It might be a little selfish of me, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if that happens, we'll get to make
fun memories like this all over again, so...”

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Maybe tonight I'll ask
Lady Shiraoki for a divine revelation before I sleep..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood! Let's go!
With you, Trainer, I'd go to the ends of the earth!"

Stepping off at the final stop... a truly idyllic,
yet utterly barren scenery stretched out before me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Inhale~, exhale~... Ahh, the air is so crisp!
It feels like the atmosphere itself is brimming with power!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Expectations are already sky-high!
All right, Trainer, let's go!

Under their expectant gazes, I roll the dice...
And after walking and walking endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... It really feels like we've finally reached the ends of the earth!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is likely the final stop of our journey...
A limited-time super power spot!
Man, I wonder what kind of miracle will happen!
choice_data_list: ...Do you think you'll really wake up?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Of course! Because this is the place you guided me to, Trainer!"

...When you say that with such a dazzling smile,
it makes even me want to believe in miracles.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What was that sound just now!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san! Look at the sky!
There's something glowing coming this way...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: W-Whoaaaaa~!?
And a blinding light and roaring sound pierced through her entire body...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You saw that too, didn't you, Trainer?
Just now...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It really was a UFO!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely it! They must have
shared the cosmic power of the universe with us~!

I didn't see it clearly, so I can't say for sure...
but well, there's no need to rain on her parade while she's so happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my destined person!
To think you could lead me to such incredible good fortune...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As long as the two of us are together,
there must be even, waaaay more amazing things waiting for us!
...Right, Trainer?!
